name: Plate tools
description: A computed pass/fail column, a header action that summarises it, and a row action that exports chosen rows.
author: Acme Bio

columns.title: Grade
columns.description: Pass at 90 or above, retest from 70, otherwise fail, worked out from viability.

row-actions.title: Export chosen rows
row-actions.description: Downloads the chosen rows as a CSV file.

row-actions.title: Inspect
row-actions.description: Shows a short card for the one chosen row.
